hypotheses.C1_full_sae_delta: The complete SAE code change reconstructs the actual eigenspace edit with median direct-write and downstream fidelity at least 0.50.
hypotheses.C2_companion_gain: A write-ranked 64-feature companion set improves downstream fidelity over the named target feature alone by at least 0.20.
hypotheses.C3_companion_compactness: The 64-feature companion set reaches at least 80% of the complete-SAE downstream fidelity.
hypotheses.C4_target_prominence: The named semantic feature is among the top 16 changed-feature write contributions in at least half of sites.
hypotheses.C5_sparse_write_energy: The median number of changed SAE features needed to capture 90% of individual decoded-write energy is at most 64.
